newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay exchange open for full session today.
newsitem.headline: Bombay exchange open for full session today.

text.p: The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) said it has extended trading time to 3.30 p.m. (1000 GMT) on Friday.
The exchange had earlier said trading will end at 2.45 p.m. (0915 GMT), 45 minutes before normal close to enable brokers to complete weekly carry-forward charges.
The charges will be transacted between 6.45 p.m. and 8.15 p.m. (1315-1445 GMT) on Friday, the BSE said.
